Overview of Sejong-si Region (Sejong-si)

Sejong-si Region (Sejong-si) is located in the Sejong-si region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Sejong-si. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic cultural district, Traditional market (Sijang), Mountain & river parks, Local museum & heritage trail.

RegionSejong-si
Capital citySejong-si
Cities & municipalities2
Primary transport hubSejong-si Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Sejong-si Region

Connected via KORAIL KTX / SRT high-speed rail, Express Bus terminals, and T-money nationwide transit card. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Sejong-si

When visiting cities across Sejong-si, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Korean BBQ (Samgyeopsal & Hanwoo)
  • Bibimbap
  • Kimchi jjigae
  • Tteokbokki & street food
  • Local makgeolli

Best time to visit Sejong-si

Best time to visit Sejong-si: Apr–May, Sep–Nov.
